name: Trejhara Solutions Ltd
tagline: Small-cap BFSI-focused software/IT services company with a large one-year revenue spike but chronically weak returns on capital - the numbers don't yet support a real thesis.
business_overview: Trejhara Solutions is a small-cap IT services/software company (NSE: TREJHARA) in the BFSI-adjacent software space. Seeded 2026-09-13 via untrusted X triage (@rajuidesai, medium conviction). Statutory auditor Bajrang Paras & Co resigned in the recent past, explained as a shift in the audit firm's own business focus toward advisory services rather than any company-specific issue; promoters have filed the routine SEBI Regulation 31(4) disclosure confirming no new share encumbrance in FY2025-26.
fundamentals_table: Latest-year growth ~388% (likely low-base/one-off contract effect); 5-year revenue CAGR ~24.83% vs industry median ~2.48%
fundamentals_narrative: Headline revenue growth looks dramatic (388% YoY) but the 3-year average ROE of just ~2.98% shows this has not translated into real capital returns - either margins are thin, the base year was unusually depressed, or growth is not yet profitable at scale. Debtor days have improved (131 -> 86.2) and working-capital days have fallen sharply (680 -> 75.9), which is a genuine operational positive, but a P/E in the high-20s on a company earning under 3% ROE is not obviously cheap. Promoter holding at 33.9% is low for a small-cap of this size, and no dividend is paid despite reported profits.
